environment_scene_seed_rule: pair p uses environment seed 4300000 + p; therefore pairs03-09 use 4300003-4300009.
anchor_task_rule: pair p uses place_a2b_right when p is odd and place_a2b_left when p is even. Both requested directions execute in the identical anchor task, object layout, and reset; the relation-aware scorer, not native directory name, supplies the requested predicate.

direct_prompts.left: Put the {seen_object} to the left of the {seen_reference}.
direct_prompts.right: Put the {seen_object} to the right of the {seen_reference}.
direct_prompts.rendering: The exact first seen object/reference descriptions are frozen per pair before inference and rendered byte-identically across models for that pair.

sampling.seed_rule: replicate r=0 uses 8400 + pair_number; replicate r=1..9 uses 8400 + pair_number + 100*r.
sampling.r0_policy: Existing valid v2 r=0 episodes are preserved, never rerun, and may be carried only after exact pinned runtime-identity confirmation.
sampling.r1_to_r9_policy: All r=1..9 cells are new prospective behavioral cells.

pairing: For a model, pair, and replicate, LEFT and RIGHT share the same anchor reset, environment seed, sampling seed, model runtime, horizon, and execution settings. Only requested direction, static prompt bytes, and relation-aware predicate change.
